title: Story Pack Flow
summary: A lore-pack foundation with Terminal, Index, MissionCore, SignalOS, Lens, HoloMap, tutorials, and SoundCore.
body: A creator-ready story foundation with chapters, archives, missions, scan objectives, map markers, and Terminal presentation examples.
steps: Use Index for player-readable lore and mechanics.
Use MissionCore for action, rewards, and pacing.
Use SignalOS and Terminal for archives and presentation.
commonMistakes: Packs with no narrative or guide content
